Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2026-10-12

Information we collect

When you submit a story we store the nickname, title, story text and optional numbers you provide. We do not require your real name or email address. Please do not include personal contact details in your story.

Cookies and advertising

Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this and other websites. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads based on your visit to our site and other sites. You may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings. Where required by law, we request your consent before using non-essential cookies.

Analytics and logs

Our hosting provider may collect standard server logs such as IP address, browser type and pages visited for security and performance purposes.

How we use information

We use submitted stories to publish them (after review) on the community page, and we use technical data to keep the site working and secure. We do not sell personal information.

Your choices

To request removal of a story you submitted, email contact@YOUR-DOMAIN.com with the story title and nickname.

Children

This site is intended for adults and is not directed to children under 13.

Changes

We may update this policy and will change the date above when we do.
